revenue_scope: U.S. Qutenza net product revenue: NeurogesX's 'Net product revenue' line through 2012Q3 and, from 2013Q3, Acorda Therapeutics' 'net revenue from the sale of Qutenza' to its specialty distributors. Acorda's rights cover the U.S., Canada and Latin America, but its 10-Q notes state that Qutenza is distributed in the United States by two specialty distributors and that net product revenues reported to date are derived from sales of Ampyra, Zanaflex and Qutenza in the United States (Q1 2014 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000100884814000030/quarterly_report-033114.htm; Q3 2015 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000100884815000054/report_quarterly-093015.htm).
moa: TRPV1 (transient receptor potential vanilloid 1) agonist; capsaicin defunctionalises cutaneous nociceptor fibres

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 022395 ... QUTENZA (capsaicin) 8% patch ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature dated 11/16/2009)

launch_evidence.quote: Since the U.S. launch of Qutenza on April 5, 2010, we recorded sales of Qutenza to its specialty distributor and specialty pharmacy customers totaling $308,000, of which $33,000 was recorded as Qutenza revenue for the second quarter 2010.

series_start_reason: 2010Q2 is the U.S. launch quarter (April 5, 2010) and the first quarter NeurogesX printed Net product revenue; the first quarter of 2010 is a printed nil in the fiscal 2010 Form 10-K quarterly table.
series_end_reason: Acorda Therapeutics prints a Qutenza net revenue figure for a quarter in its Forms 10-Q for 2013Q3 to 2015Q3 (whole dollars to 2015Q2, '$0.4 million' for 2015Q3). No later Form 10-Q read prints a quarterly Qutenza figure; its Forms 10-K give full years only, at $0.1 million precision: 2015 $1.0 million, 2016 $1.1 million, 2017 $0.7 million, 2018 $0.5 million (FY2018 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000156459019004986/acor-10k_20181231.htm). The fourth quarter of 2015 is not derived because full-year ($1.0 million) and nine-month ($0.9 million) figures are both rounded to $0.1 million. Acorda sold the rights on 2018-10-30 to Averitas Pharma (Grunenthal, private), which publishes no Qutenza figure.
notes: Scope is the line NeurogesX itself labels 'Net product revenue' (Qutenza sold by NeurogesX in the United States). Ex-U.S. Qutenza was licensed to Astellas; amounts from that agreement are reported in separate 'Revenue from the Astellas Agreement' lines and are not in this series. Acorda Therapeutics acquired the U.S., Canada and Latin America rights in July 2013 (Acorda FY2013 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000100884814000011/report_annual-123113.htm) and sold them on October 30, 2018 (FY2018 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000156459019004986/acor-10k_20181231.htm). Acorda printed Qutenza net revenue only as annual prose figures at 0.1 million precision (2013 $0.4 million, 2014 $0.9 million, 2015 $1.0 million, 2016 $1.1 million, 2017 $0.7 million, 2018 $0.5 million) plus third-quarter-2015 ($0.4 million) and third-quarter-2014 ($0.3 million) prose figures; Averitas Pharma (Grunenthal), the buyer in 2018, is private. Series ends 2015Q3 (see series_end_reason). The fiscal 2010 and 2011 fourth quarters are taken from the unaudited quarterly financial data table of each year's Form 10-K, where the fourth quarter is the current column. EXTENSION: the series is extended with Acorda Therapeutics' own quarterly prose figures (whole U.S. dollars in each Form 10-Q, recorded in millions). Acorda's 2013 fourth quarter and 2014 fourth quarter are the full year less the nine months in the third-quarter Form 10-Q. Acorda prints these figures in whole U.S. dollars (for example $103,000), so those rows carry source_unit 'units' (the base unit of the currency) with source_value_reported in dollars and value_reported in millions, the same convention gold uses for amounts too small to print in millions. Acorda's Canada and Latin America rights are part of its licence, but its 10-Q notes state that net product revenues reported to date are derived from U.S. sales (see revenue_scope).
search_log: Bigdata.com smart searches for 'Acorda Qutenza net revenue' and 'NeurogesX Qutenza net product sales' returned no documents; EDGAR submissions JSON was used directly.

Listed NeurogesX (CIK 1385830) 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q and 8-K filings from 2010 onward: 10-Qs for 2010Q1-2012Q3, 10-Ks for FY2009-FY2011, no FY2012 10-K. Read the revenue table of each 10-Q and the quarterly financial data table of the FY2010 and FY2011 10-Ks.
The Q1 2010 10-Q (0001193125-10-119068) carries no net product revenue row: Qutenza launched in the U.S. on April 5, 2010, and the FY2010 10-K quarterly table prints the first quarter as a dash.

Listed Acorda (CIK 1008848) 10-K and 10-Q filings 2013-07 to 2019-05 and grepped each for Qutenza revenue sentences: only annual figures (and third-quarter 2014 and 2015 prose figures) are printed, at 0.1 million precision; no Acorda quarterly table or release line was found for Qutenza (8-K Item 2.02 exhibits were not individually read).
Averitas Pharma (Grunenthal) is private; no filing located. Astellas ex-U.S. sales are not printed as a Qutenza line in the NeurogesX documents read.

Extension: scanned all Acorda Therapeutics (CIK 1008848) Forms 10-Q, 10-K and 8-K filed 2013-07 to 2019-06 (main documents and exhibits) for Qutenza revenue sentences; found quarterly figures in the Forms 10-Q for 2013Q3, 2014Q1-Q3, 2015Q1-Q3 and full years in the 10-Ks for FY2013-FY2018; no Qutenza revenue sentence in any 2016-2018 Form 10-Q.

Acorda's 8-K Item 2.02 exhibits and 10-Q financial statements: the revenue-sentence search matched no 8-K exhibit, and the 10-Q statements carry no per-product Qutenza row; the figures are in the MD&A prose only.
Averitas Pharma (Grunenthal) is private; no Qutenza net sales figure was found for it. Astellas (ex-U.S. licensee, outside this scope) was not searched.

unreported_quarters.2012Q4: Ownership change NeurogesX to Acorda Therapeutics. NeurogesX filed no periodic report after its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2012-09-30 (Form 8-K of 2013-03-27: 'does not currently expect to be in a position to file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2012'). Acorda acquired the Qutenza assets in July 2013 (Acorda FY2013 10-K: 'in July 2013, we acquired two neuropathic pain management assets from NeurogesX, Inc.', and NeurogesX 'had discontinued active promotion of Qutenza by the time of our purchase'); Acorda's third-quarter 2013 Form 10-Q prints the same $103,000 for the three and nine months ended 2013-09-30, so it recorded no Qutenza revenue before July 2013. No document prints Qutenza revenue for this quarter.

reviewed_anomalies.2015Q3: Acorda switched from whole dollars to millions at one decimal: 2015Q2 is $251,000 and 2015Q3 is $0.4 million; the same 10-Q prints the 2014 comparative as $0.3 million against $284,000 recorded for 2014Q3, so the step is rounding, not a change of scope.
reviewed_anomalies.2013Q3: Step from NeurogesX's last quarter (2012Q3, $583,000) to Acorda's first (2013Q3, $103,000): NeurogesX had discontinued active promotion before Acorda's July 2013 purchase and Acorda re-launched the product in January 2014 (Acorda FY2013 10-K).
